name: Plex Manufacturing Cloud
description_en:
Plex Manufacturing Cloud is retained as the catalog identity for the manufacturing software described by current Plex by Rockwell Automation materials. Rockwell’s Plex site still uses the legacy name in its Avon Machining case study and now presents manufacturing ERP within the broader Smart Manufacturing Platform. This establishes a documented product lineage, not account or contract migration.

The ERP pages connect manufacturing execution with finance, inventory, purchasing and multi-site operations. The wider platform also offers MES connected to an existing ERP; purchasing Plex does not necessarily mean replacing every enterprise system or receiving every platform module.
description_zh:
本目录保留 Plex Manufacturing Cloud 的原名称，并依据 Plex by Rockwell Automation 当前资料研究。Rockwell 的 Plex 网站在 Avon Machining 案例中仍使用旧名称，现将制造 ERP 作为 Smart Manufacturing Platform 的组成部分。这支持产品沿革的文档关联，不代表核实了账户或合同迁移。

ERP 页面将制造执行与财务、库存、采购及多工厂运营连接；更广的平台也提供连接现有 ERP 的 MES。购买 Plex 不必然意味着替换所有企业系统，也不表示获得所有平台模块。

core_features.name_zh: 制造 ERP 与集成 MES
core_features.explanation_en: The ERP documentation links production events with inventory, costing, quality and financial reporting.
core_features.explanation_zh: ERP 文档将生产事件与库存、成本、质量及财务报告关联。

core_features.explanation_en: Documented functions include supplier purchasing, financial accounts and enterprise/site-level reporting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档功能包括供应商采购、财务账户及企业与工厂层级报表。

core_features.explanation_en: The wider platform explicitly offers a MES path for manufacturers retaining their existing ERP.
core_features.explanation_zh: 更广的平台明确提供保留现有 ERP 并连接 MES 的路径。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Legacy name and current vendor documents
sections.title_zh: 旧名称与当前厂商资料
sections.en: The Rockwell-hosted Avon Machining case study explicitly names Plex Manufacturing Cloud. Current ERP and platform pages carry Rockwell/Plex branding. This is sufficient to connect the record to the cited current vendor materials without copying unrelated Rockwell product capabilities. The original plex.com endpoint had a TLS verification failure; no certificate checks were disabled and no continuity of customer contracts was inferred.
sections.zh: Rockwell 托管的 Avon Machining 案例明确提及 Plex Manufacturing Cloud，当前 ERP 及平台页采用 Rockwell/Plex 品牌。这足以将本档案关联到所引当前厂商资料，但不应复制其他 Rockwell 产品能力。原 plex.com 端点出现 TLS 校验失败；本轮未关闭证书校验，也未推断客户合同的连续性。

sections.title_en: Choose integrated ERP or a connected MES
sections.title_zh: 选择集成 ERP 或连接式 MES
sections.en: The ERP page describes integrated MES and shared manufacturing/financial data. The platform page separately offers MES connected to an existing ERP, or combined ERP/MES/SCM. An evaluation therefore needs to specify which product and modules are being purchased, which system owns finance and inventory, and how production data crosses that boundary. Platform-level edge/cloud architecture statements must not be treated as a hosting guarantee for every ERP subscription.
sections.zh: ERP 页面说明集成 MES 及共享制造与财务数据；平台页另提供连接现有 ERP 的 MES，以及组合 ERP/MES/SCM。评估时应明确购买的产品与模块、财务及库存的主系统，以及生产数据如何跨越系统边界。平台层面的边缘/云架构说明不能当作每种 ERP 订阅的托管保证。

sections.title_en: Trace a manufacturing transaction end to end
sections.en: The published scope includes RFQs, requisitions, purchase orders, inbound shipping, supplier pricing, production, quality and financial reporting. An illustrative demo could follow one purchased material through receipt, work in progress and shipment, then compare inventory and cost reporting across two sites. This is a proposed acceptance scenario; no factory, connector, financial close or live transaction was tested. Vendor case-study performance numbers are not independent benchmarks for a new installation.
sections.zh: 公开范围包括询价、请购、采购单、入库运输、供应商价格、生产、质量及财务报告。可设计演示，追踪一种采购物料从收货、在制品到发货，再比较两座工厂的库存及成本报表。这是建议验收场景，未测试工厂、连接器、关账或真实交易；厂商案例中的表现数据也不是新部署的独立基准。

sections.title_zh: 区分软件订阅与实施服务
sections.en: The professional-services terms describe a proprietary subscription platform licensed under software/cloud agreements and order forms. Implementation services are separately scoped by work orders; those service terms are not a numeric ERP subscription quote. The read ERP pages do not establish a current recurring amount, all-in implementation cost, minimum term or country-specific payroll support. Manufacturers should confirm module scope, migration ownership and support obligations before procurement.
sections.zh: 专业服务条款将平台描述为依据软件/云协议及订单提供的专有订阅平台，实施服务另由工作单规定范围；这些服务条款不是 ERP 订阅的数值报价。实读 ERP 页面没有确认当前周期费用、实施总成本、最低合同期或特定国家的工资支持。制造企业采购前应确认模块范围、迁移责任及支持义务。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Current subscription and implementation amounts, module entitlements, localization, migration and old-contract continuity remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 当前订阅及实施金额、模块权益、本地化、迁移及旧合同连续性仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: No account, ERP/MES integration, production transaction, disaster recovery or performance test was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、ERP/MES 集成、生产交易、灾备或性能测试。
